days_meaning: each delivery day costs you this much cash

messages.text: Rápido y justo: 124 P, día 10. ¿Qué día de entrega te va mejor? / Quick and fair: 124 P, day 10. Which delivery day suits you best?
Hola. I like it, and I can pay 60 P, delivery day 10.
Parece que el día te importa: 99 P con día 10. / It seems the day matters to you: 99 P, day 10.
